Meal_1: Option 1: Chicken pieces (small bowl) & paneer cubes (60 g)

Option 2: Cooked rice (3/4 cup cooked ~110 g) & grilled fish (pan fried) & spinach curry

Notes_and_Tips: Egg and shrimps are excluded as requested, so focus on chicken, fish and paneer for protein.
For better physique results, keep protein slightly higher and rice portions moderate.
During social gatherings eat chicken or fish first so overeating naturally reduces.
Choose pan fried or grilled cooking instead of oily foods to maintain steady energy.
Simple meals will help you stay consistent without needing extra cooking effort.
